soundness_flags.label: Proposition 1 (rank-one endpoint)
soundness_flags.one_line: At maximal margin, four loading lines remain distinguishable only with positive-error Gaussian pre-panel classification at every finite T0, so its risk retains a positive T0-dependent classification term as T1 tends to infinity and cannot be uniformly comparable to T1^(-1/2).

soundness_flags.label: ass:loading-gap
soundness_flags.one_line: Pairwise separation among the r signal eigenvalues is unnecessary for estimation of the rank-r projector; the signal-versus-noise gap supplied by d_lo suffices for the stated projector region.

soundness_flags.label: ass:pre-length
soundness_flags.one_line: Centered F with FF^T=T0 I_r requires only T0 at least r+1 for feasibility, so T0 at least 2r is an unmotivated stronger restriction.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 2, Assumptions 1–2 and Eq. (1), lines 99–132; Section 3.1, Assumptions 3–4, lines 142–163
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper uses fixed latent factors and stable loadings, identifies average direct/interference effects through robust regression, and imposes a majority-valid-controls condition for its fixed-N result.
Wei gives a sharp identified set under general restrictions and reduces finite-linear restrictions to compatibility of a finite linear system with uniform bootstrap inversion.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv preprint corroborating Annals of Statistics 41(6), 2013
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work studies honest adaptive confidence sets in high-dimensional sparse regression, with existence tied to separation and composite testing under observed designs.
The paper constructs finite-sample bootstrap confidence sets for spectral projectors from i.i.d. covariance observations.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Pages 1 and 14–15, Theorem 4 and proof of Theorem 1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work develops minimax expected-measure confidence sets and a Bayes-minimax duality under its restricted-location setup.
The paper develops adaptive confidence intervals for linear functionals using between-class and ordered moduli, including nonconvex parameter spaces.
The paper develops rank-sparsity incoherence and characterizes fundamental identifiability and deterministic sufficient conditions for sparse-plus-low-rank decomposition.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the endpoint oracle formula by one containing the finite-T0 four-line classification risk, or impose a stated relation such as T0 at least a constant times log(T1), then prove matching testing lower and upper bounds before retaining the adaptation-ratio claim.

Remove the within-signal loading eigengap and weaken the pre-length condition to the actual centered-normalization feasibility threshold; rederive the projector region using only the block signal-versus-noise gap.
Make the N=3 oracle experiment explicit as a four-hypothesis Gaussian decision program and use it as the first required checkpoint for the all-margin oracle handle.
